name: Ondo Perps
steps: Check you're eligible. Ondo Perps and Ondo Points exclude the US, Panama and other prohibited jurisdictions.
Sign in at app.ondoperps.xyz with email or a wallet such as MetaMask, Phantom or Coinbase Wallet.
Send USDC on Ethereum or Arbitrum, or eligible tokenized stocks on Ethereum, to your account's deposit address.
Trade perps. Your balance appears on the points page after each weekly drop.
what: Ondo Perps traders share 5 million Ondo Points a week, backdated to 2 June. What the points are, how to earn them and what trading equity perps costs.
behind: Ondo Global (Panama) Inc. operates Ondo Perps with technology from Ondo Finance, which also runs the Ondo Global Markets tokenized stock platform. The Ondo Foundation, a Cayman Islands foundation company, is its majority shareholder and runs Ondo Points. The public beta opened on 9 June 2026. costs: A promotion halves perp fees to 0.01% for makers and 0.025% for takers, from 0.02% and 0.05%. The docs don't say when it ends. Liquidations cost 1.5% of the position's value, and USDC withdrawals may carry a fee. risks: The site's eligibility terms exclude the US, Panama, Canada and sanctioned jurisdictions. Beta limits can change, including the position cap and per-asset caps on stock collateral.
